result.name: Flexible Revenue and Settlement Management
result.business_requirement: The business requires a dynamic financial framework that supports diverse partner commission structures, multi-currency transactions, and real-time reconciliation to sustain ecosystem profitability.
result.business_objective: Enable scalable monetization and accurate financial settlement across a heterogeneous network of store and delivery partners.
result.business_value: Ensures revenue integrity and partner trust while adapting to volatile market conditions and varying partner agreements.
success_measures: Real-time reconciliation completion within 5 minutes of transaction closure
Zero disputes regarding revenue share percentages per partner tier
policies_and_constraints: All settlements must comply with local financial regulations and tax laws.
Currency conversion must use real-time exchange rates from a designated source.
Revenue share logic must be auditable and immutable once finalized.
assumptions: The Payment Provider provides real-time transaction status updates.
Store Partners provide accurate inventory and sales data for validation.
risks_and_dependencies: Currency volatility may impact net revenue if hedging strategies are not implemented.
System dependency on the Payment Provider's API uptime for settlement execution.
Complexity in managing varying contract terms across different Store Partners.
